outcome.notes: Baseline S=0.636 P_band=0.497 → Iter 1A S=0.652 P_band=0.518 (220 comparisons, N=20 × 11 days). Marginal +2.5% / +4.2% gain. common_truss_status_too_advanced reduced 122→103 (-19) — phenology timing change had partial effect. However tomato_day33_fruit_too_early stayed at 20/20 (no change) — Gompertz parameter changes did not move fruit visibility at day 30. Diagnosis: GDD_to_first_flower 250→300 delayed truss emergence but Gompertz changes alone don't suppress fruit count when fertilization phase logic is the dominant driver. Engine_logic escalation (Iter 1B) needed: introduce flowerToFruitSetGDD lag, and/or visible_fruit threshold based on Gompertz phase rather than diameter.
